documents.title: New Resources Support Responsible Use of AI in Graduate Education
documents.quality_note: News post summarizing two Graduate School resources (guidance document, thesis AI usage agreement); the linked documents themselves were not fetched.

notes: URI has no university-wide coursework AI policy per secondary sources (instructors set rules). The ATL syllabus-language page https://web.uri.edu/atl/design/syllabus is inaccessible: the server 301-redirects to an unrelated Pepperdine page, so it was recorded as inaccessible and the redirect was not followed. The Graduate School's 'Responsible Use of Generative AI in Graduate Education' PDF and Thesis AI Usage Agreement are linked from the news post but their URLs were not exposed in the fetched text. No CS and Statistics department policy found. Course pages in queue.json (CSC 212, 411, 461) are deferred.
